respuesta_final:
/74 tests pass. Here's what was implemented:

**New endpoint:** `POST /api/gestion/pistas/:pistaId/bloqueos`

**Files created:**
- `src/servicios/bloqueos.ts` — the core service: validates input, checks for conflicting reservations (409 `PISTA_CON_RESERVAS`), cancels them if `cancelarReservas: true` (with notifications), saves the block, audits `bloquear_pista`
- `test/bloqueos.test.ts` — 12 tests covering happy path, availability shows `bloqueada`, blocked slots reject bookings, 409 with/without `cancelarReservas`, 403/404/400, check order, all validation edge cases, overlapping blocks

**Files modified:**
- `src/dominio/tipos.ts` — added `Bloqueo`, `BloqueoConReservas`, `CanceladaPor`, `canceladaPor?` on `Reserva`, `bloqueada` to `EstadoFranja`
- `src/dominio/errores.ts` — added `PISTA_CON_RESERVAS`
- `src/dominio/tiempo.ts` — added `HORAS_DE_FIN`, `esFinDeFranja()`, `seSolapan()`
- `src/dominio/validacion.ts` — added `finDeFranja` rule
- `src/dominio/reglas.ts` — `estadoDeFranja` now accepts bloqueos, added `comprobarQueEsBloqueoValido`
- `src/dominio/puertos.ts` — added `RepositorioBloqueos` interface
- `src/infra/repositorio.ts` — in-memory bloqueos collection with `dePistaEntre`
- `src/infra/semilla.ts` — `bloqueos: []`
- `src/servicios/servicios.ts` — registered the new service
- `src/servicios/reservas.ts` / `disponibilidad.ts` — pass bloqueos into rules
- `src/http/rutas.ts` — new route entry
- `docs/` — updated `dominio.md`, `api.md`, `arquitectura.md`, `testing.md`
